title: I wish I would have ordered sooner
text: I wish I would have ordered sooner. I have many of these containers in two sizes. No matter the size they are great for fruits and veggies that you want to keep fresh!

product_metadata.title: Kitchen Spaces Colander Stackable Food Storage Bin, Small
features: NO MORE FORGOTTEN PRODUCE - By washing your produce before you put it away and keeping it on a shelf instead of hidden in a crisper drawer, you're more likely to eat it before it's past its prime
FAST DRAINING - Colanders feature elongated holes for fast draining so your strawberries, cherries, blueberries, grapes, and other produce don't get moldy.
STACKABLE - The Small Colander Bin includes a lid so you can stack it easily with other Kitchen Spaces organizers
BPA-FREE - Suitable for use in your refrigerator, pantry, or freezer. Hand wash recommended.
description: Reveal your kitchen's storage potential with Kitchen Spaces, a line of premium kitchen organization systems for busy families at affordable prices.The Small Colander Bin is ideal for use in your refrigerator. Use the colander to easily organize your fruit and veggies that have been rinsed and are ready to use or eat. The colander fits neatly in the outer bin, which has a lid and is fully stackable.Keep your washed produce out of your crisper drawers, so you can remember to eat them before they go bad. And when your berries or fresh vegetables are already washed, there's no excuse not to eat them.
